_comment: Demo QA phrases (SYNTHETIC patients). Expectations are what is clinically CORRECT per the HEARTS rules, reviewed by hand, not just what the system currently outputs. 'expect' = field values; 'check' = fields that must be 'please check'; 'flags' = flag codes that must appear; 'noflags' = codes that must NOT appear; 'todo' = known limitation (reported, not failing). 'id' doubles as the recording file name for speech QA (data/qa/audio/<id>.wav|m4a|webm|mp3).
